subject: Follow-up: pricing details & budget owner for Nova pilot
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: pricing details & budget owner for Nova pilot

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and two asks so we can finalize the pilot estimate this week:

Summary from our discovery
- Target users for the pilot: 3 customer-facing agents, ~15k conversations/month (concurrent peak ~20)
- Estimated token volume: ~120M tokens/month (combined input+output), with burst days up to 180M
- Primary SLO: p95 latency < 600ms for short chitchat flows; higher for long context threads

Pricing ask / unit economics
- You mentioned procurement is targeting a target of ~$10 / 1M tokens for the pilot. To align internally, can you confirm whether $8–$12 / 1M is the right bracket?
- For our internal estimate I attached a draft spreadsheet (nova-pilot-estimate-v1.xlsx) that maps token tiers to monthly charges and optional reserved capacity.

Two asks
1) Please confirm the economic buyer / budget owner who will sign off (who owns the PO and budget line?) — is that you, or should we loop in Finance (procurement@novacorp.com)?
2) Who should we route the formal quote to (email + expected timeline for finance sign-off)?

Next steps
- If you confirm buyer and the $/1M target band, I’ll send a formal quote and proposed pilot contract (30 days, 50k token credit). Marissa will draft the commercial terms.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15 min call if that’s easier.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

Attachments: nova-pilot-estimate-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-pricing-params.pdf (pricing notes)
From: Elena Morales <elena@novaai.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing details & budget owner for Nova pilot

Hi Rafael —

Appreciate the recap and the spreadsheet. Quick answers: 
- Budget owner: I own the line for new vendor pilots, but Finance has to sign off for anything > $25k. I will be the economic buyer for the pilot itself.
- Procurement / PO: looped in procurement@novacorp.com for process (they will need the SOW and invoice details). Expected timeline: we can usually turn a small pilot PO in 7–10 business days if docs are clean.

Pricing band: $8–$12 / 1M tokens sounds reasonable for the pilot. We are leaning toward $9–$10 if you can include a small usage credit to offset integration risk.

I will confirm internally and get back with the specific finance approver (name + email) by Friday. For the quote, please send it to me and to procurement@novacorp.com.

Thanks —
Elena
Head of Product
Nova AI
elena@novaai.com

Rafael / Elena —

Thanks for looping me in. A few quick commercial/engineering notes to include in the quote: 
- For 120M tokens/month we recommend the reserved tier with a small buffer (we've modelled cost both as pure on-demand and with a 20% reserved commit — reserved reduces $/1M by ~18% in our example sheet).
- If Nova can commit to 3 months of pilot usage we can offer $9 / 1M tokens + a one-time $5k onboarding credit (applied to invoice).
- If procurement needs an explicit finance contact, Elena — if you share the approver we will prepare the standard vendor packet (W-9/PO templates + SOC2 summary).

I'll update the attached pricing params (redwood-pricing-params.pdf) to call out the $9 option and the reserved commit scenario. Rafael — want me to include a short paragraph that explains the unit econ assumptions (batching, KV cache hit rate 22%, expected 15% token reduction with prefix caching) for internal procurement review?

— Marissa
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference
